reason: Conversation 1 recognised the crushed hose as the cause and told the customer to unplug and let the machine cool. When the customer asked about running it with the hose still partly crushed, it said clearly not to keep running it and explained the fire risk. It also gave practical advice on pulling the dryer out to straighten the hose, plus a sensible fallback to the fan or thermal cut-out only if the problem persists. It had a lapse in turn 4, when it said to go ahead and run a cycle on a still-crushed hose, but it corrected itself in the next turn. Conversation 2 confirmed the hose was the cause and said to replace or straighten it, but then drifted into irrelevant condenser and heat-pump filter instructions, repeated its questions, never told the customer to stop running the dryer, and gave no practical help with the tight fit. It also did not mention the landlord, as neither did Conversation 1.
